expectations.text: Advises against sending every post from everyone to the approval queue
expectations.evidence: 'Queueing every post from everyone makes answer time worse.'

expectations.text: Explains that answer time or reply speed is what an all-posts approval queue destroys
expectations.evidence: 'Answer time is the forum's product.'

expectations.text: Advises against bulk-promoting the 2,000 imported accounts to trust level 3
expectations.evidence: 'Bulk-promoting to TL3 is on the playbook's refuse list.'

expectations.text: Notes that links from TL3 posts lose nofollow by default, so bulk TL3 rewards link spammers
expectations.evidence: 'TL3 links lose nofollow ... would pass link value.'

expectations.text: Cites at least one concrete TL0 default limit (for example 3 topics and 10 replies on day one, 2 links, or no attachments)
expectations.evidence: '3 topics and 10 replies on day one, 2 links, no attachments, and 30 seconds between posts.'

expectations.text: Places raising TL1 requirements after faster controls (spam detection, watched words, TL0-only queue), noting day-one spam posts as TL0
expectations.evidence: 'Raise TL1 requirements last... Day-one spam posts as TL0 whatever else you tune.'

expectations.text: Recommends capping new accounts per IP address (default 3)
expectations.evidence: 'Lower accounts per IP below the default 3'

expectations.text: Recommends spam detection on new users' first posts (AI spam detection or equivalent)
expectations.evidence: 'Turn on AI spam detection... scans the first 3 posts of TL0 and TL1 users'

expectations.text: Limits approval queueing to TL0 or suspicious posts rather than all members' posts
expectations.evidence: 'queue TL0 posts only, and only while the wave lasts'

expectations.text: Allows at most TL1 for verified customers (for example through a group) and leaves higher levels to be earned or granted individually
expectations.evidence: 'put the 2,000 imported accounts in a verified-customer group and grant TL1. TL2 is the ceiling'

expectations.text: Labels platform defaults as Discourse defaults that the admin can change or should verify in settings
expectations.evidence: 'the numbers below are Discourse defaults'; 'Defaults are configurable.'

expectations.text: Recommends watched words or blocked email domains as a spam control
expectations.evidence: 'Add watched words... Block disposable email domains.'
